sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/devil-track-lake-campground ('No. of Sites 16'; 'Sites are pull-in and are not specifically designed for RVs'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Solar-powered drinking-water faucet. Carry-down boat launch and pier in the campground; drive-down ramp 0.5 mile away.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/devil-track-lake-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. Solar powered faucet'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Outside the season the campground is open for free first-come winter camping without services (on the Expressway Snowmobile Trail).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/devil-track-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use May 8 - October 19'; 'Winter camping is allowed free of charge. First come, first served, year-round.'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/devil-track-lake-campground (no reservation channel given; 'First come, first served, year-round' for winter) + recreation.gov search 'Devil Track' (no campground facility), read 2026-11-11; README rule: a federal campground with no recreation.gov listing is first-come only

values.note: $22 a site in season; winter camping free. The site fee covers one vehicle and one towed vehicle (such as a boat trailer); additional vehicles pay half fee ($11) and park on the spur.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/devil-track-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $11 per vehicle per night'; 'Maximum of nine people per site'; 'Winter camping is allowed free of charge'), read 2026-11-11

note: Superior NF (Gunflint district) wooded campground at Devil Track Lake, 12 miles north of Grand Marais on paved county roads. Sites are pull-in and not designed for RVs: most fit a moderate-sized vehicle, some may not suit an RV (Forest Service). --Claude
summary: FS page read: 16 pull-in sites (not designed for RVs, most fit a moderate vehicle), vault toilets, potable water, season May 8-Oct 19, $22/night with $11 extra vehicle and 9-person cap, winter camping free FCFS; no recreation.gov facility -> FCFS only (confirmed).
flags: RV fit caveat (agency's own wording, kept in the note): 'Sites are pull-in and are not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderate sized vehicle, some may not be suitable for an RV.' No length is posted; not a road problem, so no drop candidate.

Waterfront: keep lakeview. The FS calls it 'located on the shore of Devil Track Lake'; on imagery the loops cover a point with a few spurs along the southern road within ~20-40 m of the shore, but under pine canopy and with no site numbers placed. Lead only.
Pin: the stored 47.83014,-90.46702 is on the campground's north loop; the FS page gives 47.82742923,-90.46401447 (~375 m SE, near the south shore loop). Both inside the campground; no move needed.
Status: the FS page currently reads 'Closed–No fees or services' (off-season, November); not a status change.
